scope: VISUAL APPEARANCE ONLY: lighting, textures, colours, mowing, sand, water, illustrative woods, sky/haze, 1.5x terrain exaggeration, camera approach (Tee view from behind the Green tee, Approach view ~100-110 m short of the green). It does NOT approve geographic outlines, reconstructed bunkers, the Green tee coordinates, GPS calculations or iPhone functionality; those keep their own checkpoints (HOLE_VALIDATION.md).
owner_words: I approve the V2 visual appearance as our standard for Pocasset AI Caddie V3. ... Do not make further significant visual changes without discussing them with me.
rule: tools/render_flyover.py refuses to render if style/flyover_style.json differs from the approved file below, unless PCV3_STYLE_CHANGE_APPROVED names an owner-approved change recorded in DECISIONS.md. Renderer code changes must keep tests/test_visual_baseline.py passing (Hole 2 renders byte-identical) or be discussed with the owner first.

camera_approach.note: Per-hole camera.json may adjust distances so the whole hole fits; the approach (where the camera stands, how high, which way it looks, image sizes) is the approved pattern.

provenance_note: 15 Nov 2026 (same day): hole02_approach.json reference refreshed because its recorded camera.json checksum predated the Tee view output-size change in the same file. Image and material IDs were confirmed byte-identical; no visual change.
change_from_previous: v1.1 -> v1.2: trees.crown_surface_fade on (a whole illustrative tree is left out when its crown would reach a tee, green, fairway, bunker or water + 2 m). Owner approved 15 Nov 2026 ("Fix both") after before/after previews of Holes 1, 2, 3, 6.
